title: Transforming Logistics: SK Cargo's Digital Journey with Polygon Technology
description:
Hear from Arefin Antu (Managing Director) and Dr. Metee (Director) of SK Cargo Limited as they share their journey of transforming a manual logistics business into a fully digital, one-stop sourcing and shipping platform.

SK Cargo Limited, a full-fledged logistics company operating between China and Bangladesh, struggled to find the right tech partner to bring their vision to life. In this video, they discuss how Polygon Technology stepped in to provide end-to-end guidance—from initial project planning and UI/UX design to development and post-launch "babysitting" support.

Discover why SK Cargo chose Polygon Technology to build their Phase 1 purchase platform and why they plan to continue this partnership for future warehouse management and shipping digitizations.

🕒 Video Chapters:

0:00 - Introduction: Meet the People Behind SK Cargo
0:32 - The Vision: Planning a One-Stop Sourcing Platform
1:30 - The Process: UI/UX, Development, and Handover Support
2:06 - The Experience: Why Process and System Matter
3:05 - Future Plan: What's Next for SK Cargo & Polygon Technology

📱 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/polygontechnologylimited
💼 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/polygontechnologylimited

asr.full_text: Hello, I'm SK Cargo Limited's Managing Director, RFE Nantoo. We're a full-fledged logistics company in Bangladesh from China. Assalamualaikum, I'm Dr. Mithi, Director of SK Cargo Limited. We have also given all around support to all these business that want to import any product from China. We have given all around support to all these business that want to import any product from China. We have been thinking for a long time about creating a platform for our clients to use for sourcing. But it didn't happen that way. prepare my clothes and everything, but things actually never went well. We had spoken to many people, but after a lot of work went very far. Actually, the planning was not successful in the last stages. So, in this situation, one day with my brother in the polygon, while talking in a casual manner, the situation arose. After that, I sat with him and discussed the project to the Plenter. He guided me on all the steps and made it possible to take to start a project. So we started our project. He helped us with all our activities for the digitalization of our non-digitalized businesses. They have done everything beautiful. This is the design I started with. I sent the development process to the developer when it was completed. Now we've received the product handover. They called it the babysitting period. After the development, we came up with the product as a handover. After the handover, this was considered as a babysitting period. They showed how to provide the right support and help, ...and how each team would utilize their handover in our hands. Also, with a sense of trust, we could solve any problems that come our way. I took care of all this for the first 3 months. If we solve the problem with any help, then this will be solved in just three months Our journey with Bollygan is actually very smooth Our customers know digitalised products from ideas They can convert them directly to online services The overall experience I was good experience. The part was that you cannot do anything with just a project. There is a process. And a system, if the system won't work, you can not work. The process that Polygon guide to megon guided me helped me. We had a future plan of creating a one stop shipping platform with one source. Which was phase 1, so phase 2, 3 will keep on providing support like they did from day one So that we can make it successful and can create a one-stop solution for our clients As a partner, the more we can get support from Polygon, and because they guided us in a good way, we are able to make it successful We can start a successful product because of people who are very kind and guide us. Though the plans for our future has not been completely realised, we hope that, in the near future, everything will all be sorted out without a mishap. We are very happy working with them. In the future, we have a target to digitalize different sectors of the company meaning digitalize various sectors of the shipments Right now, our purchase platform is ready And, in future, we hope we will work with Polygon to digitalize our warehouse management and other sectors of shipping
